n: A data center is the building where AI actually runs: rows of computers, plus the power and water that keep them going. When we read AI news, we can ask where the center sits, what it draws from the town around it, and what the town gets back. Amazon's Oct. 2 post answers those questions in its own words, and the local filings are where we check them.
